# SolveBase

> SolveBase is a free Chrome extension that automatically saves newly accepted Codeforces, LeetCode, CSES, CodeChef, and GeeksforGeeks solutions to a public GitHub repository. It organizes solution files by platform and updates the repository README summary.

SolveBase uses GitHub OAuth with the public_repo scope. It does not require a personal access token or a separate SolveBase account. Solution source code travels directly from the extension to GitHub; the SolveBase backend handles the GitHub authorization exchange.

## Product documentation

- [SolveBase](https://solvebase.dev/): Product overview and frequently asked questions.
- [Getting started](https://solvebase.dev/getting-started): Installation, supported pages, public repository requirements, GitHub permissions, and sync troubleshooting.
- [How SolveBase works](https://solvebase.dev/how-it-works): Versioned product facts with direct implementation citations, sync limits, data flow, and a comparison with manual GitHub saving.
- [How SolveBase works (Markdown)](https://solvebase.dev/how-it-works.md): The same guide as plain Markdown, including source references.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://solvebase.dev/faq): Direct answers about pricing, platform workflows, repository visibility, GitHub access, and troubleshooting. Each question has a permanent fragment link.
- [GitHub sync extension comparison](https://solvebase.dev/compare): SolveBase, original LeetHub, a specified CP Sync variant, and independent CodeHub compared using linked source snapshots.
- [Extension comparison (Markdown)](https://solvebase.dev/compare.md): The same specification table, comparison notes, and directory examples as plain Markdown.
- [LeetCode to GitHub](https://solvebase.dev/leetcode-to-github): Save accepted solutions from standard LeetCode problem pages, organized by topic.
- [Codeforces to GitHub](https://solvebase.dev/codeforces-to-github): Save accepted contest and practice solutions by rating after the final verdict.
- [Privacy policy](https://solvebase.dev/privacy): Data handling, browser permissions, local retention, and revoking access.
- [Full text reference](https://solvebase.dev/llms-full.txt): Product facts, setup steps, supported platforms, and the full FAQ in plain text.

## Current limitations

- Public GitHub repositories only. Private repositories are not supported.
- New submissions are detected while the extension is active. There is no bulk import of past platform submissions.
- LeetCode support covers standard leetcode.com/problems/ pages; contest and Explore editors are not supported in version 1.0.0.
- Codeforces pretests are not final acceptance. Pending final verdicts can be tracked locally for up to seven days.
- Accepted solutions that cannot reach GitHub immediately can be retried locally for up to 24 hours.
- Compatible existing public solutions repositories are supported. Unrelated non-empty repositories are rejected.
